claim.claim-text: 1. A dilutable concentrate for hard surface cleaners with improved film/streak performance on high-energy surfaces, comprising:

(a) from 1 to 99 wt.% of an amine-functional hydrophobe; and (b) from 1 to 99 wt.% of one or more auxiliary surfactants selected from the group consisting of anionic, nonionic, cationic, zwitterionic, and amphoteric surfactants, said wt.% values based on the amount of dilutable concentrate.
2. The concentrate of claim 1 wherein comprising 10 to 90 wt.% of the amine-functional hydrophobe and 10 to 90 wt.% of the auxiliary surfactant.
3. The concentrate of claim 1 or claim 2 wherein the amine-functional hydrophobe is a polyetheramine comprising recurring units of an alkylene oxide, a glycidyl ether, or combinations thereof.

4. The concentrate of claim 1 or claim 2 wherein the amine-functional hydrophobe is a reaction product of 2-(N-methylanilino)ethanol with 10 to 20 equivalents of propylene oxide followed by 2 to 10 equivalents of ethylene oxide.
5. The concentrate of any of claims 1 to 4 further comprising a builder, a cosolvent, or a combination thereof.
6. The concentrate of claim 5 wherein the cosolvent is a saturated or unsaturated C<8>-C<14> N,N-dialkyl amide.
7. The concentrate of any of claims 1 to 6 further comprising lactic acid.
8. A hard surface cleaner comprising water and the concentrate of any of claims 1 to 7.
9. The cleaner of claim 8 comprising 50 to 99.9 wt.% of water based on the amount of cleaner.
10. The cleaner of claim 8 or claim 9 formulated at a pH within the range of 3.0 to 9.0.
11. A dilutable concentrate for hard surface cleaners with improved film/streak performance on high-energy surfaces, comprising:
12. A hard surface cleaner comprising water and the concentrate of claim 11.
13. The cleaner of claim 12 comprising 50 to 99.9 wt.% of water based on the amount of cleaner.
